question: If 'P@Q' means 'P is the wife of Q', 'P # Q' means 'P is the son of Q', and 'P $ Q' means 'P is the father of Q', then what is the relationship of K to H in the expression: H # I @ J # K?

Given Expression: H # I @ J # K → H is son of I, I is wife of J, J is son of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e84c25f6cc6bf4b2ecd7ad42833c6f354d1535ab425643981dd33c64d3b61179.png] 

Gender of K is not given so, K is either Paternal Grandfather or Paternal Grandmother of H
